Sable scoring fingerprints the /48 IPv6 and BGP path, so a farm renting 1,000 VPS across 500 subnets still pays 500× provisioning plus subnet rotation latency. Thread the per-epoch budget: sybils need 10 epochs × 120 POA to mature, but rate caps force 333 subnets minimum. Cost grows linearly with subnets, payoff quadratically capped—negative by identity 20.
